findings.mechanism: The HFT outlier joins focus narration and song facets to recitation at 96:1, return/echo at 96:8, and calls at 96:17. The acoustic-public contact changes silent self-certification into a performed account whose circulation appears to warrant itself.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hear self-sufficiency as a voice that gains force by returning and being amplified, even though its source was received and its reach depends on others.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory acoustic-public analogy. The focus phrase remains a seeing-and-sufficiency construction; the packet explicitly limits this to analogy rather than literal singing.

epistemic.reason: The exact outlier trace has complete anchors and focus returns, but its form-distant acoustic synthesis is explicitly exploratory.

findings.title: Reflected human image
findings.claim: The focus self-image can be seen as relationally produced: a reflective surface, another pupil, or another gaze is required for even the image of independence to appear.
findings.mechanism: The HFT outlier joins focus visible appearance and seeing with the human image in the pupil, a visible mark at 96:1, and counter-seeing at 96:14. The optical-social contact changes introspective self-sufficiency into an image dependent on surfaces, signs, and another gaze.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can notice the quiet dependence inside self-image itself: what seems most private still needs something that reflects, receives, or sees it.
findings.containment: This is an exploratory optical-social analogy. The focus phrase remains the local seeing-and-sufficiency claim, and the packet limits the image to relational production rather than literal anatomy.

epistemic.reason: The exact outlier trace has complete anchors and focus returns, while its pupil/mark synthesis is explicitly exploratory.
